title: Add the AMP discriminator and tripod style reward
summary: locomotion.amp implements Liu et al.'s discriminator on 61-value AMP transitions with Table III's [1024, 512] layers, the Eq. (1) least-squares loss and the Eq. (2) style reward. It resolves the printed parameter gradient penalty as the cited AMP input-gradient penalty with coefficient 10 and records that and its other unstated choices in DECISIONS. It can fit a frozen discriminator offline from recorded traces and adds the style term to the literal or calibrated Table I rewards for the scorer and viewer through MODULE:FACTORY:CHECKPOINT reward specifications. The offline discriminator is a diagnostic: AMP trains it against the current policy during PPO. Domain randomization (Table II) changes native physics and remains Step 7.
next: Implement the Step 5 flat AMP pilot, updating the discriminator with PPO against the current policy, after the motion-prior dataset passes Step 4 review.
reason: An offline discriminator and candidate reward terms change no measured result, roadmap marker, gate or the training reward in locomotion/task.py.
